mapper.select: SELECT id, player1_id AS player1Id, player2_id AS player2Id, player1_name AS player1Name, player2_name AS player2Name, large_score AS largeScore, small_scores AS smallScores, winner_id AS winnerId, winner_name AS winnerName, created_at AS createdAt FROM `match` ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, player1_id AS player1Id, player2_id AS player2Id, player1_name AS player1Name, player2_name AS player2Name, large_score AS largeScore, small_scores AS smallScores, winner_id AS winnerId, winner_name AS winnerName, created_at AS createdAt FROM `match` WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, player1_id AS player1Id, player2_id AS player2Id, player1_name AS player1Name, player2_name AS player2Name, large_score AS largeScore, small_scores AS smallScores, winner_id AS winnerId, winner_name AS winnerName, created_at AS createdAt FROM `match` WHERE player1_id = #{playerId} OR player2_id = #{playerId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `match` (player1_id, player2_id, player1_name, player2_name, large_score, small_scores, winner_id, winner_name, created_at) VALUES (#{player1Id}, #{player2Id}, #{player1Name}, #{player2Name}, #{largeScore}, #{smallScores}, #{winnerId}, #{winnerName}, #{createdAt})
